results.title: 结构与溶剂 → HSQC 交叉峰
results.protocol: One vote per spectrum. Unambiguous metadata class, otherwise unknown. MAE per carbon index in original SMILES order. Two ordered H outputs per site.

notebook_protocol.scope: One vote per matching solvent metadata row.

website_assignment.protocol: One candidate carbon per distinct observed (C,H) pair. Accept any expert carbon sharing the exact pair. Unmatched peaks count as incorrect.
